caption:
Momo loves weekend netball, but every landing makes her knees grumble.

Jumping and landing put some of the biggest loads through your knees in sport, especially in netball, basketball, volleyball and touch. When ankles, knees and hips bend together, that load is shared.

Hybi's drill: jump off a low step with both feet, land soft and quiet with knees in line with toes, and hold 2 seconds. Do 10 reps, then progress to single-leg hops and direction changes. Squats, lunges and step-downs build the strength behind it.

A pop with swelling or a knee giving way needs an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
